headline: Fronts Roil as Base Lines Shift
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the most consequential movement has remained on the contested belts. WeatheredExpanseHex has edged up to twenty-two base events in twenty-four hours, with seven in six hours, while its ledger still reads five Warden, four Colonial. FishermansRowHex has risen to sixteen daily events, including three in the latest two hours, though all nine bases presently remain Colonial. LinnMercyHex has strengthened from the earlier report to eleven daily events and three in two hours; ten of its eleven bases are Colonial, with one neutral. StonecradleHex remains a hard-fought split of six Colonial and three Warden holdings, recording twelve daily events but no fresh turnover in six hours. FarranacCoastHex stays entirely Colonial across eleven bases after ten daily events, though its latest event was more than five hours ago. GutterHex also posted ten daily events around The Parras, but its immediate pace has cooled. StlicanShelfHex remains divided five Warden to four Colonial, with five daily events and no new change in the latest six hours. The heaviest casualty pressure is concentrated in Weathered, Stonecradle, and the surging MooringCountyHex, while CallahansPassageHex has seen intense fighting without recorded base events.
